# Hits Guide

## What is a Hit?

A Hit marks a named event — an action, stunt, or skill — at a specific count in a choreography. Hits are **independent from lineups**: a hit can exist without a corresponding lineup, and vice versa. There is no hit called "Formation 5" — hits describe _actions_, not _formations_.

## CRITICAL: How Hit Names Are Built

**Hit names are generated by the UI from a fixed cross-product of the exact parts listed below.** You MUST only use these exact values. Do NOT invent new parts, use alternative words, or modify the casing. Parts are joined with **single spaces** — no dashes, no hyphens, no other separators.

A hit name is built by concatenating up to four parts **in this exact order**:

```txt
[PreDirection] [PreAction] [Action] [PostDirection]
```

Each bracket is optional. Parts that are omitted are simply left out of the final name.

**The ONLY valid hit names are:**

- The standalone names listed in the "Standalone Hits" section below
- Any combination produced by the cross-product of the values in the PreDirection, PreAction, Action, and PostDirection tables below (omitting nulls and joining with spaces)

No other hit names exist. If a name doesn't match one of these patterns, it is invalid.

## Valid Parts

### Pre-Directions (optional prefix)

| Value |
| ----- |
| High  |
| Low   |

### Pre-Actions (optional prefix)

| Value   |
| ------- |
| Set     |
| Go      |
| Start   |
| Dip     |
| Half up |

### Post-Directions (optional suffix)

| Value        |
| ------------ |
| to the right |
| right        |
| to the left  |
| left         |
| to the back  |
| back         |
| forward      |

### Standalone Hits (used as-is, do NOT combine with other parts)

| Value       |
| ----------- |
| Clean       |
| Set down    |
| Run         |
| Switch grip |
| Grab        |
| End         |

## Valid Examples

Every name in this table is valid. Notice how each is built from the parts above:

| Hit Name                | Parts Used                         |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| Elevator                | Action                             |
| High Set Elevator       | PreDir + PreAct + Action           |
| Low Lib Stretch left    | PreDir + PreAct + Action + PostDir |
| Clean                   | Standalone                         |
| Trophy back             | Action + PostDir                   |
| Half up Cradle          | PreAct + Action                    |
| High Scale to the right | PreDir + Action + PostDir          |
| Dip Flick Flack         | PreAct + Action                    |
| Start Pyra to the left  | PreAct + Action + PostDir          |
| Set down                | Standalone                         |
| High V                  | PreDir + Action                    |
| Low Elevator            | PreDir + Action                    |
| Go Stretch              | PreAct + Action                    |
| Bike turn to the back   | Action + PostDir                   |
| Kneel                   | Action                             |
| Trophy                  | Action                             |
| 1 to the right          | Action + PostDir                   |
| High Set Lib left       | PreDir + PreAct + Action + PostDir |
| Dip Cradle              | PreAct + Action                    |
| Start Scale forward     | PreAct + Action + PostDir          |

## INVALID Examples (do NOT create these)

| Invalid Name                | Why It Is Wrong                                                |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Pre-Action - Step Right     | "Pre-Action" and "Step" are not valid parts; uses dashes       |
| Formation 5                 | Hits describe actions, not formations                          |
| Jump                        | "Jump" is not a valid Action                                   |
| High Step Right             | "Step" is not a valid Action                                   |
| Go Down                     | "Down" is not a valid PostDirection                            |
| Set down left               | "Set down" is a standalone — cannot combine with PostDir       |
| Clean to the right          | "Clean" is a standalone — cannot combine with PostDir          |
| Low Set down                | "Set down" is a standalone — cannot combine with PreDir/PreAct |
| Elevator-right              | Parts must be separated by spaces, not dashes                  |
| High set Elevator           | "set" must be capitalized as "Set"                             |
| Half-up Elevator            | "Half up" is two words, not hyphenated                         |
| Big V                       | "Big" is not a valid PreDirection                              |
| Run to the left             | "Run" is a standalone — cannot combine with PostDir            |
| Half up Stretch to the back | This is actually VALID — included here to show the pattern     |

## Agent Guidance

- **ONLY use values from the tables above.** Do not invent new action names, directions, or pre-actions. If a name is not in the tables, it does not exist in this system.
- **Parts are joined with single spaces.** Never use dashes, hyphens, or other separators between parts.
- **Capitalization matters.** Pre-Directions ("High", "Low"), Pre-Actions ("Set", "Go", "Start", "Dip", "Half up"), and Actions must use exact capitalization as shown. Post-Directions are always lowercase.
- **Standalone hits cannot be combined.** "Clean", "Set down", "Run", "Switch grip", "Grab", and "End" are used as-is. Do not add prefixes or suffixes to them.
- **Hits are not formations.** A hit like "Formation 5" is not valid. Hits describe _actions_, not _where people stand_.
- **Hits do not need a matching lineup.** A hit can exist at a count where no lineup is defined. They are independent.
- **Associate members with hits.** When creating a hit, specify which members perform the action. If you omit `memberIds`, the hit is associated with **all** members — which is the common case.
- **Bulk creation is memory-efficient.** The `create_hits` tool uses lightweight access checks — it loads only the choreography owner for authorization, not the full choreography graph. Use it to create many hits without memory issues.
- **Batch size limit.** The server accepts up to ~500 hits per `create_hits` call. For choreographies with many counts, batch your requests accordingly.
